story_type: hoist from a cruise ship far offshore
hook: 92 miles out, lifted off a cruise ship.
narration: Ninety-two miles off Kauai, a helicopter crew had to lift a passenger straight up off a cruise ship.
A sixty-one-year-old woman aboard the Japan-based cruise ship Pacific World needed a hospital, and no ambulance could reach her out here.
An MH-65 Dolphin crew from Coast Guard Air Station Barbers Point came for her.
The pilot can't see straight down, so the hoist operator watches the deck from the door and talks the pilot into position.
Then the rescue swimmer rode the cable back up over open ocean. [short pause]
outcome: The Dolphin crew flew her to Queen's Medical Center in Honolulu.
title: 92 miles out, lifted off a cruise ship
description:
A Coast Guard Air Station Barbers Point MH-65 Dolphin crew hoisted a 61-year-old passenger from the cruise ship Pacific World 92 miles offshore Kauai, Hawaii, and flew her to Queen's Medical Center in Honolulu.
